description: This file defines a static helper class `CacheHelpers` that provides utility methods for generating cache keys and default cache duration for an e-commerce web application. It includes methods to generate cache keys for catalog items, brands, and types.

classes.name: CacheHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods for generating cache keys and managing cache durations.

methods.name: GenerateCatalogItemCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key string for catalog items based on pagination and optional filters for brand and type.

methods.name: GenerateBrandsCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a fixed cache key string for the list of brands.

methods.name: GenerateTypesCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a fixed cache key string for the list of product types.
